title: Equities price-move domain (yfinance)
description: Daily OHLCV bars for a small public-equity universe. Large moves are flagged from the bars themselves (z-score of daily return, volume ratio, gap, trend regime) and described with templated cue text so the overlay can pair cause/effect. Automine collects possible driver evidence per ticker and expands catalogued sector peers. This is bound RelOp + heuristic search on measured bars — not a forecast, not investment advice, not a claim that the engine found why a price moved.

sources.note: Only daily bars and earnings dates are read. When yfinance or the network is unavailable the writer bakes a seeded series and records Source=baked on every row.

kineteqV2: Quant Finance Lab: yfinance history, technical scan, regime snapshot, cross-analysis
autocausal bridge: gate verdict supported / review_required / refused / failed on every run
CausalRun: reuse a prior run by task fingerprint instead of re-running
inspiration.notCopied: Causal News panel asks an LLM to find news and assign Bayesian posteriors. Here every cue is templated from measured bars; no news is invented and no model writes SQL.

moves.note: A move is a bar whose daily return z-score (rolling window) exceeds zThreshold. Regime is bull when close is above the regimeWindow mean, else bear.

cues.volume: {symbol} {verb} {pct}% on {date} because volume ran {vr}x its {window}-day average; therefore this was a high-volume {direction} move in a {regime} regime.
cues.gap: {symbol} {verb} {pct}% on {date} because it gapped {gap}% at the open; therefore the move was set before regular trading in a {regime} regime.
cues.regime: {symbol} {verb} {pct}% on {date} during a {regime} regime; therefore the move ran with the {regimeWindow}-day trend.
cues.event: {symbol} {verb} {pct}% on {date}, the first session after a catalogued {kind}; therefore this move may be an {kind} reaction.
cues.note: Templates only restate measured bar facts (return, volume ratio, gap, regime, catalogued event date). 'because' and 'therefore' are discourse cues so chunk_causal can pair them. They are not causal claims.

automine.causalNNote: Wide enough to cover every causal chunk of the bound text column, so each flagged move can pair with its measured driver. The hash knn ranks near-identical effect chunks together; a narrow n would drop them all.

honesty: Price-move cues are templated from measured bars (return, volume ratio, gap, regime, catalogued event dates). Possible driver evidence is heuristic. Identification is none. Not a forecast, not investment advice.
